decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 918 PL-00, 918-EX-01, 918-EX-02, 918-EX-03, 918-EX-04, 918-EX-05, 918-EX-06, 918-EX-07, 918-PL-01, Received: 10th July 2009
918-PL-02A, 918-PL-03A, 918-PL-04A, 918-PL-05A, 918-PL-06A, 918-PL-07A, Received: 28th August 2009and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Application to extend the time limit for implementation of an extant planning permission for the erection of a single storey rear extension to a house referenced 00622/3/P5 dated 01/09/2009
